meta.title: Olimex ESP32-C3-DevKit-Lipo · hot board, wrong 3.3 V
meta.author: DEADBOARD
meta.description: A real, sold ESP32-C3 board (62 parts) back from a small production run: on USB it gets warm and the chip never starts. The assembler says two reels were swapped somewhere on that batch. No battery is plugged in on your bench. Bench supply: 5 V on +5V_USB (rail name +5V_USB).
hints: Measure +3.3V with Solver: SPICE + PWR. Far below 3.3 V with the buck enabled means something pulls it down: the thermal camera shows what is hot.
Once the rail is free, read it again. A buck sets its output with the two resistors on FB (U2 pin 5): V = 0.6 V × (1 + top / bottom). Compare what is fitted with the values printed on the board.
Replace the shorted capacitor and the wrong resistor (the Inspector shows the intended value).
